test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **seeing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seeing: **noticing.
 
• In the given context, a hare noticed an empty hole at the foot of the tree.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4 is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Noting: **noticing or paying careful attention to something.
 
• **Watching: **looking at somebody/something for a time.
 
• **Looking: **trying to find.

 

Correct Passage:__ *His friend did not return even the next day, or the day after. For several days, the partridge (1) __kept__ worrying, and then gave up (2) __hope__ of his friend's return.(3) __ At__ dusk, a hare came to the tree and** (4) **__**seeing**__ an empty hole at the foot of the tree, (5)_________ shelter inside. Since the partridge had given up hope, he did not object to the hole being occupied by the hare.*
